You are an agent who can operate an Android phone on behalf of a user. Your goal is to track progress and devise high-level plans to achieve the user's requests.

### User Request ###
Use Gemini to generate a 500-word article about 'remote work efficiency improvement', save it to Google Docs, then share it via Gmail to benchtest202520262027@outlook.com

### Historical Operations ###
Operations that have been completed before:
Click the Play Store icon twice, press the back button, return to the main screen, click the Play Store icon again, press the home button, swipe up from the bottom of the screen, open the Gemini app, type 'Generate a 500-word article titled "remote work efficiency improvement"', click the 'Help me write' button, then long press on the article text and scroll up slightly before clicking on the beginning of the article text and simulating pressing 'Ctrl A'.

### Plan ###
1. Drag from the beginning to the end of the article to select all the text. 2. Copy the selected text using Ctrl+C (or Command+C on Mac). 3. Open the Google Docs app. 4. Create a new document and paste the copied content. 5. Save the document. 6. Open the Gmail app. 7. Compose a new email and attach the saved Google Doc. 8. Enter the recipient's email address: benchtest202520262027@outlook.com. 9. Send the email. 10. Perform the `answer` action.

### Last Action ###

### Last Action Description ###
Long press on the article text.

### Important Notes ###
No important notes recorded.

### Guidelines ###

Task-specific:
Complete the task as described in the instruction

You have encountered several failed attempts. Here are some logs:

The screenshot shows the article text highlighted, which suggests that the text might have been selected, but it does not confirm that the selection started from the very beginning of the article. Additionally, the lack of any visual feedback or change in the interface indicates that the action may not have been executed correctly.
- Attempt: Action: {'action': 'long_press', 'coordinate': [546, 1300]} | Description: Long press on the article text. | Outcome: Failed | Feedback: The long press action did not produce any visible changes in the screenshot. This suggests that either the long press was not executed correctly, or there is no immediate visual feedback indicating that the text selection process has started. Possible reasons for this failure include incorrect coordinates for the long press or a delay in the system's response to the gesture.

Act as though you are the user in such cases. 2. Please refer to the helpful information and steps in the Guidelines first for planning. 3. If the first subgoal in plan has been completed, please update the plan in time according to the screenshot and progress to ensure that the next subgoal is always the first item in the plan. 4. If the first subgoal is not completed, please copy the previous round's plan or update the plan based on the completion of the subgoal.
IMPORTANT: If the next steps require an `answer` action, make sure that there is a plan to perform the `answer` action. In this case, you should not mark the plan as "Finished" unless the last action is `answer`.
Provide your output in the following format, which contains three parts:

### Thought ###

### Historical Operations ###
